definitions.explanation: The body of rules and structures by which taxes are levied and collected — including tax types, rates, exemptions, and administrative procedures. A standard term in news and policy discussion.

examples.japanese: {税制|ぜいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{税制|ぜいせい}⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The government is pushing forward with tax-system reform.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中小企業|ちゅうしょうきぎょう}→中小企業：24117_chuushoukigyou⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧な{税制|ぜいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}される→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: A tax scheme favorable to small and medium enterprises is scheduled to be introduced.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧ (tax) + ⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ (system). Refers to the structural side of taxation — the rules and design — rather than tax amounts or individual tax payments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税制|ぜいせい}⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧: tax reform
- {税制|ぜいせい}{改正|かいせい}: tax-code amendment
- {税制|ぜいせい}{優遇|ゆうぐう}: preferential tax treatment
- ⟦{現行|げんこう}→現行：13503_genkou⟧{税制|ぜいせい}: the current tax system
- {税制|ぜいせい}{調査会|ちょうさかい}: Tax Commission (advisory body)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧: tax — the money paid, not the system
- {租税|そぜい}: taxes — formal/legal term
- ⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧: public finance — broader; includes spending as well as taxation
